title: End Game
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Taylor Swift
I wanna be your end game
I wanna be your first string
I wanna be your -Team
N..
I wanna be your end game, end game
Post-Chorus: Taylor Swift

[bridge]
Ooh, you and me, we got big reputations
Ahh, and you heard about me
Ooh, I got some big enemies (ya)

[bridge]
Ooh, you and me would be big conversation
Ahh, and I heard about you
Ooh, you like the bad ones, too

[verse]
You so dope, don't overdose, I so stoked, I need toast
We do the most, I'm in the Ghost, like I'm whippin' boat, boat
I got reputation, girl, that don precede me (ya)
I'm call away whenever you need me (yeah)
I'm in (ya), come to the -side (ya)
I got bad boy persona, that's what they like (what they like)
You love it, I love it too 'cause you my type (my type)
N..
You hold me down and I protect you with my life (my life)

[pre_chorus]
I don't wanna touch you, I don't wanna be
Just another ex-love you don't wanna see
I don wanna miss you (I don wanna miss you) like the other girls do
I don't wanna hurt you, I just wanna be
Drinking on beach with you all over me
I know what they all say (I know what they all say) but I ain tryna play
Taylor Swift
I wanna be your end game
I wanna be your first string
I wanna be your -Team
N..
I wanna be your end game, end game

[verse]
Knew it when I was young, we connected, when we were little bit older

[bridge]
Reputation precedes me, and rumors are knee-deep
The truth is it's easier to ignore it, believe me
Even when we' argue, we' not do it for long
And you understand the good and bad end up in song
For all your beautiful traits and the way you do it with ease
N..
For all my flaws, paranoia, and insecurities
I made mistakes and made some choices, that's hard to deny
After the storm, something was born on the fourth of July
I've passed days without fun, this end game is the one
With four words on the tip of my tongue, I'll never say it

[pre_chorus]
I don't wanna touch you, I don't wanna be
Just another ex-love you don't wanna see
I don wanna miss you (I don wanna miss you) like the other girls do
I don't wanna hurt you, I just wanna be
Drinking on beach with you all over me
I know what they all say (I know what they all say) but I ain tryna play
Taylor Swift
I wanna be your end game
I wanna be your first string
I wanna be your -Team
N..
I wanna be your end game, end game
Post-Chorus: Taylor Swift

[bridge]
Ooh, you and me, we got big reputations
Ahh, and you heard about me
Ooh, I got some big enemies (hey)

[bridge]
Ooh, you and me would be big conversation
Ahh, and I heard about you
Ooh, you like the bad ones, too

[verse]
I hit you like bang, we tried to forget it, but we just couldn't
And I bury hatchets but I keep maps of where I put '
Reputation precedes me, they told you I'm crazy
N..
I swear I don't love the drama, it loves me
And I can't let you go, your hand prints on my soul
It's like your eyes are liquor, it's like your body is gold
You've been calling my bluff on all my usual tricks
So here's the truth from my red lips
Taylor Swift
I wanna be your end game (end game)
I wanna be your first string (first string)
I wanna be your -Team (-Team)
I wanna be your end game, end game
I wanna be your end game (oh, I do)
I wanna be your first string (first string)
I wanna be your -Team (-Team)
I wanna be your end game, end game
